procedure: Never commit credentials or log SQLite encryption keys.
Use `resolvePublicCred()` for public upstream OAuth identifiers; never add them as string literals. See [`docs/security/PUBLIC_CREDS.md`](docs/security/PUBLIC_CREDS.md).

Use `buildErrorBody()` or `sanitizeErrorMessage()` for HTTP, SSE, executor, and MCP errors; do not return raw `err.stack` or `err.message`. See [`docs/security/ERROR_SANITIZATION.md`](docs/security/ERROR_SANITIZATION.md).
Keep database operations in `src/lib/db/`; do not issue raw SQL from routes.
Do not close a contributor pull request after using its code; merge it through GitHub so the contributor receives credit.
This checkout is a fork of `diegosouzapw/OmniRoute`. Keep fork-only deployment and personal automation changes out of upstream PRs.
rollback: Keep the record as candidate or delete it before promotion.
